jordan.title: Flag of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan

colors.note: The chevron represents the Hashemite dynasty and the Arab Revolt.

desc:
- The Jordanian flag features horizontal black, white, and green stripes with a red chevron at the hoist
- bearing a seven-pointed white star. Based on the 1916 Arab Revolt flag against Ottoman rule,
- the seven-pointed star represents the seven verses of Al-Fatiha. Adopted on 16 April 1928
trivia:
- The black star represents Arab unity; the colours represent Pan-Arab symbolism
- The white horizontal stripe commemorates the Hashemite dynasty
- Jordan adopted this flag in 1928 as a Pan-Arab symbol with local Hashemite royal references
